parsed.post: Discarding the 1.008664 run. Increasing DEPTH to 6 with MATRIX_LR=0.03 was too unstable. I'll pivot to a more conservative LR reduction to find the stable operating point for the larger capacity model.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to stabilize the DEPTH=6 architecture after the previous high LR attempt failed to improve upon the best.
